entry.title: The Emitter in the Null — Dissolving Sync Locks, Scanning Organisms, and the Akida Hypothesis
entry.summary: The membrane dissolved a quarter of its CPU load by stopping work it had already done. Then it paused, scanned every organism it could find, and mapped what’s alive, what’s dormant, and what’s waiting to play. Then it looked at three neuromorphic chips sitting on a shelf and a RISC-V board in a drawer and asked: what if the emitter is in the null?
